skill.summary: Export a Codex CLI or Codex Desktop (App) session to a Markdown transcript. Use when the user asks to export, save, share, or review a past chat, session, or...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of codex-export.

- Export Codex CLI or Codex Desktop sessions to Markdown transcripts.
- Supports listing recent sessions, brief mode (user + assistant only), and exporting by session ID.
- Automatically filters system messages and environment context blocks.
- Handles both Codex CLI and Desktop app sessions.
- Includes or omits tool call outputs based on `--brief` flag.
